action.name: Compute SHA256 Checksum
action.command: kitty -e bash -c 'echo -e "\033[1;36m[SHA256 CHECKSUM]\033[0m\n"; sha256sum "%f"; echo ""; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'
action.description: Calculate SHA256 cryptographic hash of target file
